shortDescription: Fetches the latest version of a GitHub project and returns it.

options.name: cache
options.description: Defines the validity of the meta information in seconds. If this expires, the meta information is reloaded from GitHub. This is to prevent the rate limit from being used unnecessarily.

options.name: filter_elements
options.description: defined a list for a filter. all hits are excluded from the final result

options.name: github_releases
options.description: Searches for the last published Git release

options.name: github_tags
options.description: Search for the last published Git Tag

options.name: only_version
options.description: returns only Versionnumbers without leading 'v' or 'V'

options.name: project
options.description: Defines the project in which a repository has been created. For example: **prometheus**/alertmanager

options.name: repository
options.description: Defines the repository that is maintained underneath a project. For example: prometheus/**alertmanager**

options.name: without_beta
options.description: Removes possible beta versions from the results.
